title: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance dictionaries (Hebrew and Greek)
author: James Strong (1894)
edition: Open Scriptures JSON edition (David Instone-Brewer XML; Unicode transliterations by David Troidl)
rightsNote: Underlying 1894 dictionaries are public domain; the Open Scriptures JSON edition is CC BY-SA. Attribute Open Scriptures; share modifications of the data under the same license.
citation: Strong, James. A Concise Dictionary of the Words in the Hebrew Bible / Greek Testament (1894). Open Scriptures JSON edition, CC BY-SA.
limitations: Strong's glosses are 19th-century summaries keyed to KJV renderings; they are a starting point, not a modern lexicon. Aramaic entries are within the Hebrew numbering.
